song.title: Over The Hills And Far Away

guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul Standard / Fender Telecaster / Danelectro
guitar.evidence: Jimmy Page's 1959 Gibson Les Paul ('Number One') is one of the most iconic guitars in rock history, alongside his well-documented use of a Telecaster (Stairway to Heaven solo) and Danelectro for alternate tunings.

tone.target: bright acoustic-like clean with slight edge and dry room
tone.profile: bright acoustic-like clean with slight edge and dry room
tone.summary: A clear, fingerpicked arpeggio tone using a Vox-style preamp (UK 45) combined with light compression and a small cabinet/room simulation for brightness and definition.

rig.name: Led Zeppelin - Over The Hills And Far Away - Valeton GP-180
